name: Tool — OpenAPI
summary: OpenApiTool: pass an OpenAPI 3.x spec so the agent can call any HTTP API as a tool.
description: `OpenApiTool` attaches an OpenAPI document to a Prompt Agent so the model can call operations described by the spec while the orchestrator is `{connection}/{deployment}`. This enables API actions from a BYOM-routed agent without giving the tool a separate model.
notes:
Verified end-to-end with `OpenApiTool` on a BYOM-routed Prompt Agent. See `test.py`.

Set `OPENAPI_SPEC_PATH` to a spec file such as a simple `petstore.json`. OpenAPI tools are on the official BYOM-supported tools list.
